title: The impact of social media usage frequency on air travel behavior: an empirical analysis from China
core_idea: Examine how the frequency of social media usage influences Chinese residents' air travel behavior by integrating the theory of planned behavior and media system dependency theory, using 2022 CFPS data and multiple empirical methods (logit, IV, mediation, marginal effects, Blinder-Oaxaca decomposition) to investigate mechanisms and heterogeneity.
tldr: Investigates the relationship between social media usage frequency and air travel behavior in China using TPB and MSD frameworks with 2022 CFPS data and a suite of empirical methods to probe behavioral mechanisms and heterogenous effects.
